en-US.DESC_OTTO_HIGHBPM_ON: On: Otto uses the color below while the level's top BPM is 300+ (where vanilla turns him red). Off: the normal color is always used.
en-US.DESC_OTTO_IMAGE: Pick any PNG or JPG to stand in for Otto. Without one, the cat that ships with the mod is used.
en-US.DESC_OTTO_TINT_IMAGE: On: your own image is painted with the colors below, like the built-in one. Off: it keeps its own colors and only dims while auto is off.
